title: US Announcement—July 1955: Soviet announcement of Sputnik
lineage: Inspected the identified passage; retained file is a short paraphrased research note, not a full copy.

passages.note: NASA reprints the TASS statement that a Soviet satellite was placed in orbit; it describes a spherical satellite with mass 83.6 kg and two transmitters. Introductory headnote dates launch to October 4.
